One DualShock 4 controller is shown, camouflage-colored, resting on the console.
No power brick, cables, box, or UK receipt is visible in either photo.
Surface shows light dust/fingerprints but no visible cracks, dents, or liquid damage.
No screen is on to show the system menu, so software state, game installs, or storage health cannot be seen.

A close-up photo of the HDMI and power ports.
A photo of the UK receipt or any UK-market sticker/label on the unit.

response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a used PS4 Fat console with one controller, but functional claims (working, no overheating, 10 games) and origin (UK) are unverifiable from photos alone, and the mention of non-existent game titles undermines the games claim, so it must be priced at worst case as an unverified, single-pad, origin-unconfirmed unit.
